title: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal & Helpline 1930
purpose: Citizen Financial Cyber Fraud Reporting System to freeze defrauded funds in transit within the banking network and register formal cybercrime complaints.
helpline: 1930 (National Cyber Financial Fraud Helpline - Toll Free)
guidance_notes: Call 1930 immediately within the golden hour (first 2-4 hours) of an unauthorized financial transfer to increase likelihood of fund lien/freezing by banks.

title: SEBI SCORES 2.0 (SEBI Complaints Redress System)
jurisdiction: India (Securities and Exchange Board of India)
purpose: Centralized grievance redress mechanism for investors against SEBI-regulated entities (brokers, depository participants, mutual funds, listed companies).
guidance_notes: Requires registration details of the regulated entity. Use when an entity you dealt with claims SEBI regulation or fails to resolve your grievance.

title: SEBI Intermediary Verification Register
jurisdiction: India (Securities and Exchange Board of India)
purpose: Official public searchable registry to verify whether an investment advisor, research analyst, broker, or portfolio manager is legitimately registered with SEBI.
guidance_notes: Check registration number, registered name, and contact details. Legitimate registered advisors never guarantee fixed returns or ask for fund deposits into personal savings accounts.

title: RBI Sachet Portal (Unregistered Financial Entities)
purpose: State Level Coordination Committee initiative to report and check unauthorized deposit-taking, unregulated Ponzi schemes, and illegal investment apps.
guidance_notes: Allows retail investors to check the Alert List of non-permitted Forex/trading platforms and lodge reports against unapproved deposit collection.

title: NSDL Investor Services & Grievance Portal
purpose: Verification of Demat account holdings, CAS (Consolidated Account Statement), and grievance redressal for securities deposited with NSDL.
guidance_notes: Monitor your CAS monthly to ensure all share allotments, purchases, and sales correspond strictly to your authorized market transactions.

title: CDSL Investor Services & Grievance Mechanism
purpose: Verification of electronic holdings, SMS alerts for securities debits, and direct grievance submission.
guidance_notes: Ensure your mobile number is registered with CDSL/NSDL so you receive instant debit warnings whenever shares move from your demat account.

title: RBI CMS (Complaint Management System) - Banking Ombudsman
purpose: Escalation to Banking Ombudsman if your bank fails to respond or refuses to register an unauthorized transaction complaint within 30 days.
guidance_notes: You must lodge an initial complaint with your bank first. Under RBI guidelines (2017), reporting an unauthorized transaction within 3 days limits customer liability to zero.

title: BSE Investor Services & Arbitration
purpose: Redressal of investor claims against trading members and registered stockbrokers.
guidance_notes: Useful if a registered broker executed unapproved trades or disputes arise regarding trade confirmation or settlement.

title: NSE Investor Protection & Grievance Cell
purpose: Filing claims, verifying authorized trading members, and accessing the Investor Protection Fund (IPF).
guidance_notes: Verify member credentials before depositing margins. Registered trading accounts are never funded through personal UPI IDs or unrelated individual accounts.
